thread:
Maria C: Heads up — we need a concrete plan for the tenant opt-in cutover to routing v2. Customer asks + Q2 roadmap pressure. Can we align on: canary slices, telemetry gates, fallback/kill-switches, and comms?
Aj Patel: +1. Thinking staged cohort rollout: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% over ~48h, with automatic rollback on SLO breaches.
Samir: infra notes: v2 routes are compatible with v1 fallback tokens. We should reserve burst capacity and pre-warm cache shards for canary cohorts. Also need a checklist for model variant fallback mapping.
Jessie: For the A/B piece, suggest randomized 5% of traffic with shadow logging for 24h before affecting responses. That gives quality delta + regressions quickly.
Maria C: Telemetry proposal: evaluate at each step for 30m windows on: error-rate (5xx), p50/p95 latency, user-visible hallucination regressions (from eval set), and per-token cost delta. Gate thresholds: 5xx > 0.5% OR p95 increase > 30% -> pause and roll back.
Aj Patel: Ops runbook snippet for quick rollback:
```
# toggle flag to revert
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle \
  -d '{"flag": "route_v2_enabled", "cohort": "all", "value": false}' \
  # or use ops UI: /flags route_v2_enabled -> off
```
Samir: We'll add two automated fallbacks: 1) model-variant fallback (v2 -> v2-quant) when GPU OOM observed, 2) route-level fallback to v1 when global 5xx crosses threshold. Both are handled by routing policy service; I'll attach the policy id.
ops-bot: deploybot: Canaries scheduled: routing-service:v2 -> start 2026-06-18T15:00Z for cohort 1%. Watch: #eng-oncall.
Jessie: Need to be explicit about experiment metrics: sample size for A/B test, acceptance criteria for quality delta (we should require <1.5% drop in correctness on our eval set). Also plan for a manual freeze window if any enterprise customer flagged.
Maria C: Communication plan: send a targeted advisory to affected customers 48h before 20% cutover. Postmortem template ready if rollback. Also record a Loom of the rollback steps for CS.
Aj Patel: Who owns the rollout ops? Propose Aj + Samir as leads, Jessie on metrics, Maria as PM owner. Can we get a quick sign-off by EOD?
Samir: Ack. I'll create the routing policy PR and the small playbook in runbooks/tenant-cutover.md.
Jessie: I'll build the dashboard in observability: routing_v2_canary (errors, latencies, quality_score, cost_delta). Link to query: https://observability/internal/d/abc123/routing_v2_canary
Maria C: Perfect. Final ask: add a fallback smoke test in CI that simulates a 5xx spike and verifies route-level fallback triggers within 60s. Can someone pick that up?
Aj Patel: I'll take CI smoke.
Maria C: Great — owners set. I'll prep customer advisory draft and prod launch checklist. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
